# Born East Solutions

> Born East Solutions is a small business consultancy for UK hospitality. We support restaurants, cafés, pubs and takeaways with HR and employment, food safety records, business and operations support, and customer experience. The scope and fee are agreed before any work begins.

We work like part of your team without being on your payroll, so owners can focus on running the business. The website is available in English and Thai.

## Services

- [People & Employment](https://borneastsolutions.com/people-employment): HR and employment support for businesses without an in-house HR team: recruitment and onboarding, disciplinary and grievance matters, contracts and HR policies.
- [Food Safety Support](https://borneastsolutions.com/food-safety): Food safety admin: temperature, cleaning and delivery logs set up, records kept complete and inspection-ready, staff followed up and the allergen matrix kept current.
- [Business Support](https://borneastsolutions.com/business-planning): Day-to-day operations, service standards, business planning and an extra pair of hands to get things done.
- [Customer Experience](https://borneastsolutions.com/customer-experience): Handling complaints and feedback, improving team communication and creating a more consistent standard of customer service.

## About and working together

- [About us](https://borneastsolutions.com/about): Who we are and our background in HR and business management.
- [How we work](https://borneastsolutions.com/how-we-work): Advice and consultation, project support or ongoing support.
- [Contact](https://borneastsolutions.com/contact): Tell us about your business and what you need help with.
